job.title: Senior Consultant, SAP CX, CPQ & SAP Service Support (m/f/x)

tailoring.headline: Senior Consultant, SAP CX & Commerce Cloud Developer | Java, Spring, API Integration
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, REST/OCC APIs and end-to-end PIM/ERP/MDM integrations. Proven techno-functional consultant: gathered requirements, wrote user stories, designed data flows and supported production. Strong in CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes and AI-assisted development, ready to drive SAP CX initiatives.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior Consultant, SAP CX, CPQ & SAP Service Support (m/f/x)
cover_en.hook: I am excited by ORBIS SE’s vision to innovate customer experience and service support. With 5+ years leading SAP Commerce Cloud projects at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep SAP CX expertise and a proven record of delivering complex integrations and business-focused solutions.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Cloud Expertise
bullets.text: Designed and implemented end-to-end SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) solutions, delivering product, catalog and pricing functionality that aligns with CX best practices.

bullets.label: API & Integration Leadership
bullets.text: Developed OCC REST services and built PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines (Profisee, DataHub) to synchronize product data across ERP and MDM systems, ensuring seamless CX integration.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Consulting
bullets.text: Worked directly with international business stakeholders to analyse requirements, write user stories and functional specs, translating them into robust SAP Commerce implementations.

bullets.label: Production & DevOps Excellence
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2, managed Docker/Kubernetes environments and provided 24/7 production support, guaranteeing high-availability CX services.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, Germany, with a valid work permit. Serving notice until 15.12.2026, earliest start 16.12.2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to ORBIS SE.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Senior Consultant, SAP CX, CPQ & SAP Service Support (m/f/x)
cover_de.hook: Die ambitionierte Ausrichtung von ORBIS SE im Bereich Customer Experience begeistert mich. Mit über 5 Jahren Erfahrung in SAP Commerce Cloud-Projekten bei Rockwell Automation und Shell bringe ich fundiertes SAP-CX-Know-how und nachweisliche Erfolge in der Umsetzung komplexer Integrationen mit.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Cloud Expertise
bullets.text: Entwickelte und implementierte umfassende SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) Lösungen für Produkt-, Katalog- und Preismanagement, die den CX-Standards entsprechen.

bullets.label: API- und Integrationsleitung
bullets.text: Erstellte OCC-REST-Services und konzipierte PIM-zu-Hybris Datenpipelines (Profisee, DataHub) zur Synchronisation von Produktdaten über ERP- und MDM-Systeme hinweg.

bullets.label: Techno-funktionale Beratung
bullets.text: Analysierte gemeinsam mit internationalen Fachbereichen Anforderungen, erstellte User Stories und funktionale Spezifikationen und setzte diese in robusten SAP-Commerce-Lösungen um.

bullets.label: Produktions- und DevOps-Kompetenz
bullets.text: Führte CI/CD-Deployments auf CCv2 durch, betreute Docker/Kubernetes-Umgebungen und gewährleistete 24/7-Produktionssupport für hochverfügbare CX-Services.

cover_de.logistics: Ich lebe in Karlsruhe, besitze eine uneingeschränkte Arbeitserlaubnis und befinde mich bis zum 15.12.2026 in der Kündigungsfrist. Ein Einstieg ab dem 16.12.2026 ist möglich. Gerne erläutere ich in einem Gespräch, wie ich ORBIS SE unterstützen kann.

tailoring.why_company: ORBIS SE stands out for its commitment to shaping the future of customer experience through innovative SAP CX and service solutions. Your focus on integrating CPQ and service support into a unified platform aligns perfectly with my background in SAP Commerce Cloud, API integration and techno-functional consulting. I am eager to contribute my expertise to drive seamless CX transformations for your global clients.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to help ORBIS SE deliver cutting-edge SAP CX solutions, leveraging my SAP Commerce Cloud and integration experience to create seamless customer journeys.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud consultant with 5+ years of CX integration experience. I’m very interested in the Senior Consultant role at ORBIS SE and would love to discuss how I can add value.
tailoring.email_subject: Application – Senior Consultant, SAP CX, CPQ & SAP Service Support
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Senior Consultant, SAP CX, CPQ & SAP Service Support position. With over five years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am confident I can contribute to ORBIS SE’s CX initiatives.

I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my fit.
